purpose: Exercise one visible native TableView delegate and both QtQuick ScrollBar orientations after the earlier page-name collision skipped these targets.

method.hover: Synthetic pointer motion to each target center; 300 ms cold check then poll for display.
method.criteria: Hint stays within screen and outside owner bounds, remains at same position for 400 ms, closes after pointer exit.
method.user_session: :70 preserved; all probes ran only on private :76.

diagnosis.QtQuick6 first attempt: The first custom probe reported no visible targets. A separate page diagnostic showed 48 items visible, including a table cell and both scrollbars. The cause was the probe variant that changed dynamic object names, not a product failure. The final QtQuick6 probe reused the working R4 QML instrumentation and identified controls by tooltip text and geometry; it passed all three targets.
diagnosis.host_warnings: The private D-Bus/portal emitted inotify and FUSE warnings; they did not prevent the final isolated gallery or hover checks. KDE TabButton logged a null-y warning during QtQuick6 diagnostics; the tested table and scrollbar controls still mapped and passed.

limits: This covers one TableView delegate plus one horizontal and one vertical scrollbar per version. It does not test scroll interaction, other TableView rows, other layouts, color/pixel fidelity or human acceptance. T07 remains open.
